en: A black-and-white aerial photograph of a small rural settlement, featuring a prominent white church with a tall, pointed steeple and a separate wooden bell tower, surrounded by trees and a cemetery. The surrounding area consists of a few residential buildings, open fields, and what appears to be a school with several smaller buildings. The roads are unpaved, and the landscape is distinctly northern European, with dense forests and open farmlands.
